events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) establishes legal position in Hield's (SAC) path and slightly extends his arms agianst Hield's (SAC) back, but he is able to move through contact.
Millsap (DEN) places a hand/arm to the front of Bogdanovic (SAC) at the start of the drive, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Millsap (DEN) makes contact to Bogdanovic's (SAC) elbow during his shooting motion and affects his jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) and Koufos (SAC) both get a hand on the ball and Jokic dislodges it from Koufos.
Murray (DEN) establishes a legal position in Koufos' (SAC) path and they engage and disengage.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Fox (SAC) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in a legal position in the path of Fox (SAC) and absorbs the contact.
Fox (SAC) extends a bent forearm to Barton's (DEN) off-arm but doesn't affect his SQBR.
RAR shows Fox (SAC) makes contact with Barton's (DEN) body/shoulder during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Koufos (SAC) makes some contact with Millsap (DEN) during the rebound, but contact does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Barnes (SAC) clamps Jokic's (DEN) arms during the rebound and affects his ability to retrieve the ball.
RATR shows Hield (SAC) and Murray (DEN) engage and separate during the screen.
Hield (SAC) and Morris (DEN) connect after the dribble hand off as the defenders switch. Hield is in Morris' path and does not deliver contact.
Morris (DEN) makes contact to the arm of Cauley-Stein (SAC) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Bogdanovic (SAC) puts a forearm against Barton's (DEN) side during the pick, but contact does not affect his SQBR.
Hield (SAC) places two hands to Jokic's (DEN) front while he has the ball and clamps Jokic's arm during the drive.
RAR shows Cauley-Stein (SAC) legally dislodges the ball from Jokic (DEN) during his drive.
Morris (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Bogdanovic (SAC).
RAR shows Cauley-Stein (SAC) jumps A to B into Jokic's (DEN) body, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Barnes (SAC) makes marginal contact to the body of Jokic (DEN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
LLB shows Morris (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on Hield's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
Millsap (DEN) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Fox (SAC) and gives him room to avoid contact.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in a legal position in the path of Fox (SAC). He reaches forward, creating contact when Fox turns into him.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes marginal contact to the arm of Jokic (DEN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) slightly extends his arm against Hield (SAC) front during the rebound, but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Hield (SAC) makes marginal contact to the body of Jokic (DEN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his play at the basket.
The crew communicated with the Replay Center to review the basket interference. After review, the ruling was overturned to no basket interference.
Bogdanovic (SAC) makes marginal contact with Ferrell (SAC) off ball that does not affect his ability to defend the pass.
Barton (DEN) briefly grasps Fox's (SAC) arms but contact does not affect his FOM.
